name: Vapin Ape | 2g Full Spectrum Disposable | Blue Dream
description:
Blue Dream, a legendary hybrid masterpiece that harmoniously weaves together the nostalgic sweetness of sun-drenched berries with a crisp, revitalizing breeze of forest pine. This iconic flavor profile creates a balanced and serene sensory journey, evoking the feeling of a peaceful morning walk through a sprawling blueberry field. Prepare to drift into a state of perfect equilibrium as Blue Dream gently washes away tension, replacing it with a wave of calm euphoria and a clear, creative focus that stays with you. 

Enhanced by the elegant presence of Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene terpenes, this strain offers a sophisticated fusion of sugary fruit and herbal earthiness that leaves you feeling both grounded and weightless. Immerse yourself in the dreamy embrace of Blue Dream and let its soothing, multifaceted effects carry you to a place of total tranquility and inspired bliss. 

Taste & Aroma: Fresh Blueberry, Crisp Pine, Herbal Earth. Effect: Balanced, Euphoric, Creative
